log.reply:
Dear Ms Whitfield,

Thank you for the discovery conversation of 6 October 2026. This letter proposes the Executive Briefing for Tamarack Instruments.

**Situation summary.** Tamarack Instruments operates in the Netherlands, Germany and the United States. The Client has a customer service chatbot deployed on its support portal, an AI visual inspection pilot on the German production line and AI sales forecasting planned for next year. Your stated objective is to have governance in place before visual inspection goes into production in Q2 2027. The June 2026 internal audit finding that no inventory of AI systems exists gives that objective a clear starting point. The Client's existing ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO 9001 management systems provide a foundation to extend rather than replace. ISO/IEC 42001 work is expected to begin next year, although the start date is not yet fixed.

**What the Briefing covers for the Client.** The session is designed for the General Counsel, CISO, Head of Quality, Head of Data, German plant manager and two internal auditors. We will map the EU AI Act and GDPR to each use case as expectations to verify with counsel. This includes transparency expectations for the chatbot, whether visual inspection could fall into a higher-risk category and AI literacy expectations for staff. United States obligations were not named as a driver, so they will appear only as general landscape items clearly labeled as such.

The readiness discussion will reflect the Client's piloting maturity and show how an AI system inventory responds to the audit finding. We will also address how EU data residency for customer data and German works council consultation shape the path to production. The operating model overview draws on the GRC Workbook (https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) and Slow AI Kitchen (https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen), with board-layer reference to AI Governance for Boards (https://github.com/rolldabones/ai-governance-for-boards). Three principles guide the session: Slow AI, Informed Intent, Final Liability rests with the Human.

**Logistics and price.** The Briefing is a two-hour live virtual session priced at US$3,000. The session date is Unknown and will be agreed with you. The fee sits within the budget approved for this fiscal year.

**What the Client receives afterward.** You will receive a written summary memo covering the decisions surfaced and our readiness observations. It will also set out three prioritized recommendations, each mapped to a possible next program option with its price, duration and proposed timeline. The Briefing is not legal advice. It does not promise certification, audit outcomes or regulatory approval.

**Next step.** Your decision is expected by 15 December 2026. We suggest you reply to confirm a session date and attendee list so the Briefing can take place before year end and inform planning toward Q2 2027.

Kind regards,

Unknown
AI Governance Academy

Human-made, for Easy Work, Simply Done.
